gen-gf-warnes-gf-oxygen: Warnes draws wire-thin, bent-paperclip strokes that taper out before they touch, stretched wide with loose spacing. Oxygen follows in sans-serif, its curves left open and its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans is a sans-serif with one stroke thickness throughout, and its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp even when shrunk down. Warnes above it is the showy one.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-pathway-extreme: Expressive lettering up top, with Warnes stretching its strokes wide and never swelling like a brush anywhere along them. Pathway Extreme sits below, sturdy and sans.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-preahvihear: Bold and spread out, Warnes holds a single constant stroke width across every letter in the headline. Preahvihear, a sans-serif with a lofty x-height and open mouths, fills in beneath.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-prompt: Approachable is Prompt's whole manner, with oversized small letters and open apertures. Warnes handles the loud, heavy-bowled display work, while Prompt, a sans-serif, takes over the reading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-pt-sans-caption: Wire-like and stretched wide, Warnes keeps a monoline skeleton running through every letter it draws. PT Sans Caption brings big-bodied lowercase and unclosed bowls, a plain sans that is easy to settle into.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-puritan: Warnes keeps a constant stroke from top to baseline, with tapered ink ends that stop short of touching. Puritan, a plain sans, brings rounded forms that stay open and oversized counters, which makes the pair feel friendly.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-questrial: Questrial is a sans with a flat, stencil-cut feel and a tall band of letters under short stalks. And Warnes stretches out above it, bold and loosely spaced.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-radio-canada: Contemporary lettering leads, with Warnes tapering its ink strokes wide. Radio Canada, a sans with tall c, s and z and a clear opening at every curve, then carries a longer passage in a steady line with no pressure variation.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big fills the line with a generous x-height. Warnes, stretched and expressive with ink strokes that taper out, gives the sans-serif body a bold, loose-limbed partner.
